posts.title: Mince Pie Fest 2026: Costa Coffee
posts.description: A surprise entry! A lovely texture on the pastry, and not too sweet, although there is the barest hint of a cheesy aftertaste. There's not a lot of filling, but what's there is tasty, with strong spicy flavours. Much better than I was expecting! 4 out of 5... but at £3.10 per pie (!) I'm not sure I can recommend. (Palm oil... unknown) #MincePieFest2026 #MincePieADay

posts.title: Mince Pie Fest 2026: Waitrose
posts.description: These are chunky and hefty pies, with a strong fruity scent. There's a firm, biscuity pastry, just the right side of crunchy, but far too much sugar. The filling is rich and fruity, but there's not a lot of spice, and it's all overpowered by the sugary crust. Almost very good! 3 out of 5. (NO palm oil) #MincePieFest2026 #MincePieADay
